themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying demands for policies that prioritize citizens over immigrants, particularly in housing, social benefits, and employment. This theme reflects a coordinated effort to institutionalize nationalist agendas, with Vox in Spain, Lega in Italy, and Rassemblement National in France leading the charge. The framing often ties immigration to economic strain and cultural erosion, resonating with anti-globalist rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands 'national priority' in housing and social benefits, threatening to withdraw from regional coalitions if demands are not met (e.g., Andalusia, Murcia).

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega advocates for 'remigration' policies and opposes labor immigration, framing it as a threat to local economies (e.g., Skellefteå debate).

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Proposes air conditioning in schools and hospitals as 'essential infrastructure,' framing it as a national priority over climate policies.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Criticizes EU migration policies and emphasizes national sovereignty in resource allocation, particularly in housing and social services.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Advocates for stricter immigration controls and prioritizes Polish citizens in social welfare programs, often linking immigration to security threats.

themes.title: Manuel Adorni scandal paralyzes Argentina's government
themes.blurb: The resignation of Manuel Adorni, Argentina's Chief of Cabinet, amid corruption allegations has triggered a political crisis within President Javier Milei's administration. The scandal has exposed internal divisions, with allies abandoning Adorni and judicial investigations intensifying. The cross-national resonance stems from the broader trend of far-right leaders facing accountability for corruption, a pattern seen in other countries like the U.S. and Italy.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Adorni's resignation amid illicit enrichment allegations and judicial investigations has destabilized Milei's government, with potential successors like Diego Santilli emerging.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Parallels drawn to Trump's administration, where corruption scandals and resignations (e.g., John Bolton) have similarly disrupted governance.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italy's far-right has faced similar scandals, such as Salvini's legal troubles, which have weakened coalition stability.

themes.title: Trump-Meloni diplomatic fallout escalates
themes.blurb: The public spat between former U.S. President Donald Trump and Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has escalated, with Trump accusing Meloni of 'begging' for a photo at the G7 summit. The fallout reflects broader tensions between far-right leaders over diplomatic priorities, particularly regarding U.S. foreign policy and NATO alliances. This theme resonates in countries where far-right leaders are navigating relationships with Trump's administration.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump's public criticism of Meloni over a G7 photo request has strained relations, with Trump framing it as a sign of weakness.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni's government faces internal and external pressure over its handling of U.S.-Italy relations, with Salvini and other allies questioning her diplomatic strategy.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella have commented on the spat, using it to critique Meloni's leadership and emphasize France's independent stance.

themes.title: AfD's constitutional crisis and far-right extremism
themes.blurb: Germany's far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) party faces a constitutional crisis as legal experts and opposition groups push for its ban, citing anti-democratic rhetoric and ties to extremist movements. The AfD's rise has sparked debates about the limits of free speech, the role of intelligence agencies, and the broader threat of far-right extremism in Europe. This theme is echoed in other countries where far-right parties are gaining ground, such as France and Spain.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD faces potential ban after legal reports deem it unconstitutional, with internal leadership disputes and protests against its extremist rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN faces similar scrutiny over extremist ties, with Jordan Bardella altering his public image to distance the party from far-right associations.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox's rhetoric and policies, particularly on immigration and national sovereignty, have drawn comparisons to AfD's extremist stance, sparking debates about its constitutional legitimacy.

themes.title: Poland-Ukraine tensions over historical symbols
themes.blurb: Tensions between Poland and Ukraine have escalated over historical symbols, particularly the revocation of Ukraine's highest honor from President Volodymyr Zelensky by Polish President Karol Nawrocki. The dispute reflects broader regional conflicts over historical narratives, sovereignty, and the legacy of World War II. This theme resonates in countries like Hungary and the U.S., where far-right leaders are navigating similar historical and geopolitical tensions.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Nawrocki's decision to revoke Zelensky's Order of the White Eagle has sparked diplomatic tensions, with PiS leaders defending the move as a response to Ukraine's historical revisionism.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungary's government has criticized Ukraine's historical policies, aligning with Poland's stance and emphasizing national sovereignty in historical narratives.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump's administration has weighed in on the dispute, with figures like Marco Rubio criticizing Ukraine's historical symbols and supporting Poland's position.
